# Vue Toastification (@erag/vue-toastification)

> Lightweight, high-performance toast notifications and promise-based confirmation modals for Vue 3 with Apple-style smooth animations and Composition API.

## Core Information
- **Package**: `@erag/vue-toastification`
- **Documentation**: https://erag.in/vue-toastification/
- **Repository**: https://github.com/eramitgupta/vue-toastification
- **Author**: Er Amit Gupta (https://erag.in/)
- **License**: MIT
- **Keywords**: vue, vue3, toast, notification, modal, dialog, alert, composition-api

## Quick Installation
```bash
npm install @erag/vue-toastification
# or
pnpm add @erag/vue-toastification
# or
yarn add @erag/vue-toastification
```

## Quick Start

### 1. Global Plugin Registration (main.ts)
```typescript
import { createApp } from 'vue'
import App from './App.vue'
import ToastPlugin from '@erag/vue-toastification'
import '@erag/vue-toastification/dist/style.css'

const app = createApp(App)
app.use(ToastPlugin, {
  position: 'bottom-right',
  duration: 4500
})
app.mount('#app')
```

### 2. Triggering Toasts (useToast)
```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { useToast } from '@erag/vue-toastification'

const { success, error, warning, info } = useToast()

function notify() {
  success('Project successfully saved!', 'Saved')
  error('Failed to connect to database.', 'Connection Error')
}
</script>
```

### 3. Awaiting Confirmation Modals (useModal)
```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { useModal } from '@erag/vue-toastification'

const { confirm } = useModal()

async function handleDelete() {
  const confirmed = await confirm({
    title: 'Delete Item?',
    message: 'This action cannot be undone. Are you sure?',
    confirmText: 'Delete',
    cancelText: 'Keep Item'
  })

  if (confirmed) {
    // execute deletion logic
  }
}
</script>
```
